# Generated by the USSR spirit consolidation.
# The USSR holds at most one spirit per slot (political, security, military);
# everything else is folded into the SOV_state_of_the_union dynamic modifier.

SOV_clear_political_spirit = {
	if = { limit = { has_idea = SOV_Delayed_Presidium_Countermeasures } remove_ideas = SOV_Delayed_Presidium_Countermeasures }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = SOV_Pledged_Allegiance_to_the_Presidium } remove_ideas = SOV_Pledged_Allegiance_to_the_Presidium }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = SOV_Cautious_Destalinization } remove_ideas = SOV_Cautious_Destalinization }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = SOV_Malenkov_Allies } remove_ideas = SOV_Malenkov_Allies }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = SOV_Party_Privileges_Cut } remove_ideas = SOV_Party_Privileges_Cut }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = SOV_Condemnetion_of_Bureaucratism_and_Corruption } remove_ideas = SOV_Condemnetion_of_Bureaucratism_and_Corruption }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = SOV_Khrushchev_Exclusion_From_Presidium } remove_ideas = SOV_Khrushchev_Exclusion_From_Presidium }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = SOV_Khrushchevites_in_Presidium } remove_ideas = SOV_Khrushchevites_in_Presidium }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = SOV_Malenkov_Resignation } remove_ideas = SOV_Malenkov_Resignation }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = SOV_Khrushchev_Politiburo } remove_ideas = SOV_Khrushchev_Politiburo }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = SOV_Anti_Party_Group_Coup } remove_ideas = SOV_Anti_Party_Group_Coup }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = SOV_Measures_Against_Khrushchevites } remove_ideas = SOV_Measures_Against_Khrushchevites }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = SOV_Khrushchevites_Purge } remove_ideas = SOV_Khrushchevites_Purge }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = SOV_Stabiilised_Politiburo } remove_ideas = SOV_Stabiilised_Politiburo }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = Fragile_Kaganovich_Rule } remove_ideas = Fragile_Kaganovich_Rule }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = Kaganovichism_successful } remove_ideas = Kaganovichism_successful }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = Kaganovichism_cemented } remove_ideas = Kaganovichism_cemented }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = SOV_New_Soviet_Man } remove_ideas = SOV_New_Soviet_Man }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = SOV_Decriminialized_Homosexuality } remove_ideas = SOV_Decriminialized_Homosexuality }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = SOV_Soviet_Cultural_Renaissance } remove_ideas = SOV_Soviet_Cultural_Renaissance }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = SOV_Discipline_strengthening_initiative } remove_ideas = SOV_Discipline_strengthening_initiative }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = SOV_Campaign_on_Strengthening_Labour_Discipline } remove_ideas = SOV_Campaign_on_Strengthening_Labour_Discipline }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = SOV_Campaign_on_Strengthening_Labour_Discipline_Improved } remove_ideas = SOV_Campaign_on_Strengthening_Labour_Discipline_Improved }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = SOV_Campaign_on_Strengthening_Labour_Discipline_Improved_again } remove_ideas = SOV_Campaign_on_Strengthening_Labour_Discipline_Improved_again }
}
SOV_clear_security_spirit = {
	if = { limit = { has_idea = SOV_MGB } remove_ideas = SOV_MGB }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = SOV_MGBMVD } remove_ideas = SOV_MGBMVD }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = SOV_Merkulov_in_Power } remove_ideas = SOV_Merkulov_in_Power }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = SOV_Meshik_Allied } remove_ideas = SOV_Meshik_Allied }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = SOV_Dekanozov_Allied } remove_ideas = SOV_Dekanozov_Allied }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = SOV_MVD_IN_CONTROL } remove_ideas = SOV_MVD_IN_CONTROL }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = SOV_Beria_State_of_Emergency } remove_ideas = SOV_Beria_State_of_Emergency }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = SOV_MGB_ongoing_Purge } remove_ideas = SOV_MGB_ongoing_Purge }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = SOV_KGB } remove_ideas = SOV_KGB }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = SOV_KGB_Improved } remove_ideas = SOV_KGB_Improved }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = SOV_MGB_Army_Joint_IAC } remove_ideas = SOV_MGB_Army_Joint_IAC }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = SOV_Preparation_for_an_anti_corruption_campaign } remove_ideas = SOV_Preparation_for_an_anti_corruption_campaign }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = SOV_Anti_corruption_campaign_in_MVD } remove_ideas = SOV_Anti_corruption_campaign_in_MVD }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = SOV_Wide_anti_corruption_campaign } remove_ideas = SOV_Wide_anti_corruption_campaign }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = SOV_ANTI_MISINFORMATION } remove_ideas = SOV_ANTI_MISINFORMATION }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = SOV_ANTI_MISINFORMATION_1 } remove_ideas = SOV_ANTI_MISINFORMATION_1 }
}
SOV_clear_military_spirit = {
	if = { limit = { has_idea = victor_of_the_great_patriotic_war } remove_ideas = victor_of_the_great_patriotic_war }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = Politicized_Army_1 } remove_ideas = Politicized_Army_1 }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = Politicized_Army_2 } remove_ideas = Politicized_Army_2 }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = Politicized_Army_3 } remove_ideas = Politicized_Army_3 }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = experienced_nonc_combating_officers_ranks } remove_ideas = experienced_nonc_combating_officers_ranks }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = SOV_experienced_army } remove_ideas = SOV_experienced_army }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = SOV_experienced_army_2 } remove_ideas = SOV_experienced_army_2 }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = SOV_experienced_army_3 } remove_ideas = SOV_experienced_army_3 }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = SOV_experienced_army_4 } remove_ideas = SOV_experienced_army_4 }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = SOV_experienced_army_5 } remove_ideas = SOV_experienced_army_5 }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = great_liberation_war } remove_ideas = great_liberation_war }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = great_liberation_war_2 } remove_ideas = great_liberation_war_2 }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = great_liberation_war_3 } remove_ideas = great_liberation_war_3 }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = the_last_war } remove_ideas = the_last_war }
}

SOV_sotu_ensure = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = SOV_state_of_the_union } } }
		add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = SOV_state_of_the_union }
	}
}

# --- remove effects (defined first: the add effects call them) ---

SOV_sotu_sub_gossnab = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = SOV_sotu_gossnab }
		custom_effect_tooltip = SOV_sotu_sub_tt
		show_ideas_tooltip = gossnab
		hidden_effect = {
			clr_country_flag = SOV_sotu_gossnab
			add_to_variable = { SOV_sotu_political_power_factor = -0.05 }
			add_to_variable = { SOV_sotu_supply_consumption_factor = -0.05 }
			add_to_variable = { SOV_sotu_stability_factor = -0.03 }
			add_to_variable = { SOV_sotu_production_speed_buildings_factor = 0.05 }
			add_to_variable = { SOV_sotu_production_factory_max_efficiency_factor = 0.05 }
			add_to_variable = { SOV_sotu_production_factory_efficiency_gain_factor = 0.05 }
			add_to_variable = { SOV_sotu_base_fuel_gain_factor = 0.05 }
			force_update_dynamic_modifier = yes
		}
	}
}

SOV_sotu_sub_antiquated_infrastructure = {

		limit = { has_country_flag = SOV_sotu_antiquated_infrastructure }

		show_ideas_tooltip = antiquated_infrastructure
		hidden_effect = {
			clr_country_flag = SOV_sotu_antiquated_infrastructure
			add_to_variable = { SOV_sotu_planning_speed = 0.1 }
			add_to_variable = { SOV_sotu_army_speed_factor = 0.1 }
			add_to_variable = { SOV_sotu_production_speed_buildings_factor = 0.2 }
			force_update_dynamic_modifier = yes
		}
	}
}
